title: Al-Hafiz: The Divine Name Yusuf Used About Himself
excerpt: Al-Hafiz occurs twelve times in the Quran, and one of them is not about God. Standing before the king of Egypt, Yusuf describes himself with the same word — and the tradition treats that as entirely ordinary.
seo_title: Al-Hafiz: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Hafiz, the Preserver, appears twelve times in the Quran — and once Yusuf uses it of himself. What the root means and why the tradition is untroubled.
